text: Deadlines are a part of everyday life, and handling them well is a valuable skill. Good time management is essential, so start by breaking large tasks into smaller, manageable steps. This makes the work feel less overwhelming. Next, learn to prioritize. Ask yourself which tasks are the most important or urgent, and focus on those first. It is also crucial to manage your scope. This means being realistic about what you can achieve in the given time, and not taking on more than you can handle. Finally, keep communication open. If you see a problem coming, tell your team or boss early. This gives everyone time to adjust the plan, rather than facing a surprise at the last minute.
